review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 21) consolidates Lessons 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem; Mupanda 1/3/18 Prefix (mu-); Mupanda 8 Adverbial/Stative Concord (zvaka-); Mupanda 11 (ru-) Labialized Prefix (rw-). Example utterances reviewed: "Vhara musuwo zvakasimba kana uchibuda mumba." | "Rwendo rwacho rwakareba asi tichasvika hedu." | "ndakazvitakura ndinofungidzira kuti shupa yangu yaputika asi manje handizivi kuti ndoita sei"

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Vhara musuwo zvakasimba kana uchibuda ______.' (Close the door firmly when you leave the house.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'mumba' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Rwendo rwacho rwakareba asi tichasvika ______.' (The journey itself is long, but we will eventually arrive.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'hedu' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndakazvitakura ndinofungidzira kuti shupa yangu yaputika asi manje handizivi kuti ndoita ______' (Expectant mother's health inquiry in Zezuru: 'ndakazvitakura ndinofungidzira kuti shupa yangu yaputika asi manje handizivi kut')
review_exercises.explanation: 'sei' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndakazvitakura asi mazi kumbo angu ari kuzvimba mazuva ano chii chingange chiri ______' (I am pregnant and my legs have been swelling lately; what could be causing this and how can I be helped?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'kundinetsa' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'inhumbu yangu yekutanga ndingadewo kuziva kuti ndinotanga kuenda ku ku clinic ______' (Expectant mother's health inquiry in Zezuru: 'inhumbu yangu yekutanga ndingadewo kuziva kuti ndinotanga kuenda ku ku clinic zv')
review_exercises.explanation: 'zvarinhi' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'mwana wangu mudiki anga arikupisa muviri kubva zuro ndingada kuziva kuti ndingaita sei kuti ______' (My young child has had a high fever since yesterday; I would like to know how I can help bring the temperature down.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'abatsirike' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.
